desc:
Welcome to Indonesia Driving Experience (IDEX)

Race through Indonesian streets in a variety of vehicles — from tuned diesel trucks to powerful supercars. Modify your car inside and out with performance upgrades and visual customization, then show off your build in freeroam with friends.

Update v1.2
- Highway Map Rework
- Dynamic FOV
- Bug Fixes & Adjustments

Controls
- Horn (H)
- Lights (L)
- Fog Light (J)
- DRL (N)
- Flash (F)
- Free Cam (Ctrl + P)
- Start Engine (G)
- First Person Cam (V)
- Look Around in First Person (B)
- Transmission (M)

Disclaimer:
This game is still under development and may not be optimized for your device. Join our Community Server for more information.
